up: Return a list of compounds that have exact IC50 activity values measured in nM against the human 5-lipoxygenase target. For each matching activity, provide the compound's ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES, the assay description, and the PubMed ID or DOI for the reference.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, ass.description, COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id WHERE td.pref_name = '5-lipoxygenase' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
